-- shop_items table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS shop_items \(
  id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  code VARCHAR\(100\) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  name VARCHAR\(255\) NOT NULL,
  type VARCHAR\(50\) NOT NULL,
  price INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  currency VARCHAR\(20\) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'coins'
\);

-- user_customization table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS user_customization \(
  user_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES users\(id\) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  skin_id INTEGER REFERENCES shop_items\(id\),
  effect_id INTEGER REFERENCES shop_items\(id\),
  animation_hit_id INTEGER REFERENCES shop_items\(id\),
  animation_miss_id INTEGER REFERENCES shop_items\(id\),
  animation_win_id INTEGER REFERENCES shop_items\(id\),
  animation_lose_id INTEGER REFERENCES shop_items\(id\)
\);

-- user_items table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS user_items \(
  id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  user_id INTEGER REFERENCES users\(id\) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  item_id INTEGER REFERENCES shop_items\(id\) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  UNIQUE\(user_id, item_id\)
\);

-- friends table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS friends \(
  id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  requester_id INTEGER REFERENCES users\(id\) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  addressee_id INTEGER REFERENCES users\(id\) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  status VARCHAR\(20\) DEFAULT 'pending',
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  UNIQUE\(requester_id, addressee_id\)
\);

-- game_invites table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS game_invites \(
  id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  from_user_id INTEGER REFERENCES users\(id\) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  to_user_id INTEGER REFERENCES users\(id\) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  room_id INTEGER REFERENCES rooms\(id\) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
\);
